mapper.select: SELECT id, member_id, goal_id, region_code, snapshot_ym, age, net_assets, goal_type, housing_type, deal_type, target_amount, achievement_rate, prep_months, monthly_saving, monthly_income, income_bracket, occupation_type, created_at FROM goal_snapshot WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND snapshot_ym = #{snapshotYm}

SELECT m.id AS member_id, g.id AS goal_id, gh.region_code AS region_code, TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, m.birth_date, #{baseDate}) AS age, (a.total_assets - a.loan_balance) AS net_assets, g.goal_type AS goal_type, gh.housing_type AS housing_type, gh.deal_type AS deal_type, g.target_amount AS target_amount,
CASE WHEN g.target_amount > 0 THEN LEAST(100, GREATEST(0, ROUND((a.total_assets - a.loan_balance) * 100 / g.target_amount, 2))) ELSE NULL END AS achievement_rate, CASE WHEN g.id IS NOT NULL THEN GREATEST(0, TIMESTAMPDIFF(MONTH, DATE(g.created_at), g.target_date)) ELSE NULL END AS prep_months, g.monthly_saving AS monthly_saving, m.monthly_income AS monthly_income, m.income_bracket AS income_bracket, m.occupation_type AS occupation_type FROM member m JOIN asset_summary a ON a.member_id = m.id LEFT JOIN goal g ON g.member_id = m.id AND g.status = 'ACTIVE' AND g.id = ( SELECT MAX(g2.id) FROM goal g2 WHERE g2.member_id = m.id AND g2.status = 'ACTIVE' ) LEFT JOIN goal_housing gh ON gh.goal_id = g.id WHERE m.id = #{memberId}

SELECT g.member_id AS member_id, g.id AS goal_id, gh.region_code AS region_code, TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, m.birth_date, #{baseDate}) AS age, (a.total_assets - a.loan_balance) AS net_assets, g.goal_type AS goal_type, gh.housing_type AS housing_type, gh.deal_type AS deal_type, g.target_amount AS target_amount,
LEAST(100, GREATEST(0, ROUND((a.total_assets - a.loan_balance) * 100 / g.target_amount, 2))) AS achievement_rate,
GREATEST(0, TIMESTAMPDIFF(MONTH, DATE(g.created_at), g.target_date)) AS prep_months, g.monthly_saving AS monthly_saving, m.monthly_income AS monthly_income, m.income_bracket AS income_bracket, m.occupation_type AS occupation_type FROM goal g JOIN goal_housing gh ON gh.goal_id = g.id JOIN member m ON m.id = g.member_id JOIN asset_summary a ON a.member_id = g.member_id WHERE g.member_id = #{memberId} AND g.status = 'ACTIVE'
AND g.target_amount > 0
ORDER BY g.id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT deal_type AS dealType, COUNT(*) AS `count` FROM goal_snapshot
GROUP BY deal_type ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC

SELECT ROUND(AVG(net_assets)) AS averageNetAssets, ROUND(AVG(target_amount)) AS averageTargetAmount, ROUND(AVG(prep_months)) AS averagePrepMonths, ROUND(AVG(achievement_rate), 1) AS cohortAverageRate FROM goal_snapshot

SELECT g.region_code AS regionCode, r.sigungu AS regionName, COUNT(*) AS `count` FROM goal_snapshot g JOIN region r ON r.code = g.region_code
GROUP BY g.region_code, r.sigungu ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, g.region_code LIMIT 3

SELECT LEAST(FLOOR(achievement_rate / 10), 8) AS bucketIndex, COUNT(*) AS `count` FROM goal_snapshot
GROUP BY LEAST(FLOOR(achievement_rate / 10), 8) ORDER BY bucketIndex

SELECT MIN(monthly_saving) AS cohortRangeMin, MAX(monthly_saving) AS cohortRangeMax FROM ( SELECT monthly_saving, NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY monthly_saving) AS quartile FROM goal_snapshot
) t WHERE quartile IN (2, 3)

SELECT income_bracket AS incomeBracket, COUNT(*) AS `count` FROM goal_snapshot
AND income_bracket IS NOT NULL GROUP BY income_bracket ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC

SELECT occupation_type AS occupationType, COUNT(*) AS `count` FROM goal_snapshot
AND occupation_type IS NOT NULL GROUP BY occupation_type ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC

INSERT INTO goal_snapshot ( member_id, goal_id, region_code, snapshot_ym, age, net_assets, goal_type, housing_type, deal_type, target_amount, achievement_rate, prep_months, monthly_saving, monthly_income, income_bracket, occupation_type ) SELECT g.member_id, g.id, gh.region_code, #{snapshotYm}, TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, m.birth_date, #{baseDate}), a.net_assets, g.goal_type, gh.housing_type, gh.deal_type, g.target_amount,
LEAST(100, GREATEST(0, ROUND(a.net_assets * 100 / g.target_amount, 2))),
GREATEST(0, TIMESTAMPDIFF(MONTH, DATE(g.created_at), g.target_date)), g.monthly_saving, m.monthly_income, m.income_bracket, m.occupation_type FROM goal g JOIN goal_housing gh ON gh.goal_id = g.id JOIN member m ON m.id = g.member_id JOIN asset_snapshot a ON a.member_id = g.member_id AND a.snapshot_ym = #{snapshotYm} WHERE g.status = 'ACTIVE'
AND g.target_amount > 0
AND g.id = (SELECT MAX(g2.id) FROM goal g2 WHERE g2.member_id = g.member_id AND g2.status = 'ACTIVE') ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE goal_id = VALUES(goal_id), region_code = VALUES(region_code), age = VALUES(age), net_assets = VALUES(net_assets), goal_type = VALUES(goal_type), housing_type = VALUES(housing_type), deal_type = VALUES(deal_type), target_amount = VALUES(target_amount), achievement_rate = VALUES(achievement_rate), prep_months = VALUES(prep_months), monthly_saving = VALUES(monthly_saving), monthly_income = VALUES(monthly_income), income_bracket = VALUES(income_bracket), occupation_type = VALUES(occupation_type)
